name: Luganda
region: Central Uganda (Buganda): Kampala, Wakiso, Mukono, Masaka and the Buganda kingdom
translator_note: Everyday Kampala Luganda, the register of a young professional talking to a friend: 'Kwata ku UG' for Book, 'Kubira essimu' for Call ahead, 'awatali jaamu' and 'essaawa za jaamu' for off-peak and rush hour, 'ssente z'oku ssimu' for mobile money. Buganda standard orthography with geminates written double (emmotoka, essimu, ssente, ebbeeyi). The four verbs are Genda, Gabana, Pangisa, Tuma, in the hero and everywhere else they appear; an earlier version rendered the first as 'Linnya' and that reading is retired. Product and technical terms with no settled Luganda word (plug-in, endpoint, API key, sandbox, arbitrage desk, concierge) are paraphrased or carried as loans and listed under uncertain.

strings.page.p.ug_speaks_the_languages: UG eyogera ennimi za Uganda, ez'ekitundu kino, n'ez'abagenyi baayo. Londa olulimi lwo; byonna bigoberera.
strings.top.p.one_app_that_quotes: App emu ekulaga ebbeeyi za buli lugendo ku katale ka Uganda nga ziriraanye, egabanya olugendo olw'ewala ne Prado n'ekusasuza kimu kya kuna, ekupangisa emmotoka bw'oba weetaaga okutuuka obulungi, era ekukwatira paaka nga ppaamiti tezinnaggwaawo. Osasula nga Kampala bw'esasula: ku ssente z'oku ssimu.
strings.doorRiderSub: Kwata entebe, geraageranya olugendo lwonna, teekateeka wiikendi.
strings.doorDriverSub: Gamba w'oyagala okuvuga. Entambula ezisasuliddwa zikujjira.
strings.top.div.prototype_v1_every_price: Ekigezesebwa v1 · buli bbeeyi kubalirira okuva mu nkola efulumiziddwa · okusasula kukolebwa mu kifo ky'okugezesa · wano tewannabaawo mpeereza ekkirizibwa mu mateeka
strings.compare.h2.every_ride_on_the: Entambula zonna eziri ku katale, ku sikuliini emu, nga zisengekeddwa okusinziira ku bbeeyi.
strings.compare.summary.what_choosing_badly_cost: Okulonda obubi kukusasuza ki <small>enjawulo mu bbeeyi ku katale ku lugendo luno</small>
strings.compare.summary.the_atlas_every_way: Atulasi · buli ngeri y'okutambula, mu lukalala lumu <small>ennyonyi, baasi, amaato, eggaali y'omukka, emmotoka za Signature, w'osula, n'amazima agakwata ku mbeera ya buli kimu</small>
strings.compare.p.book_on_ug_where: Kwata ku UG awali omukutu, Kubira essimu awatali, Kiri ku lukalala okukimanya, Kijja ku ebyo ebikyazimbibwa. Ebbeeyi zibalirirwa era zikigamba.
strings.stage.div.the_virtual_stage_seats: Siteegi ku ssimu · entebe zisooka kujjula, olwo emmotoka n'ejja
strings.stage.p.like_a_matatu_stage: Nga siteegi ya taxi, emmotoka esimbula nga ejjudde oba essaawa bw'etuuka. Okwawukana ku siteegi, osasulira entebe ng'oli ku sofa yo awaka, ebbeeyi y'entebe ekka nga mikwano gyo bwe gyeyongera, era dereeva agitwala yali amaze okugamba nti oluguudo olwo alumanyi bulungi.
strings.stage.summary.where_stages_fill_fastest: Siteegi gye zijjulira amangu <small>Pulse · entebe ezisasuliddwa ku maapu z'obwesigwa bwa badereeva, buli kibuga</small>
strings.stage.summary.buses_on_this_corridor: Baasi ku kkubo lino <small>eky'okuddukiramu, okuliraana ne siteegi</small>
strings.stage.p.every_corridor_also_has: Buli kkubo nalyo lirina baasi. Geraageranya essaawa z'okusimbula za kkampuni ez'enjawulo, laba paaka gy'osimbulira, era okwate ku UG kkampuni bw'eba ekkiriza okukwata ku mutimbagano. Bw'eba tekkiriza, tukigamba era tukuwa ennamba y'okukubira, mu kifo kya ppeesa etakola.
strings.stage.p.every_rental_with_driver: Buli mmotoka epangisiddwa ne dereeva na buli lugendo olugabanibwa lulina engeri y'okudda. Olugendo olugenda bwe lukwatibwa, entebe z'okudda zitandika okutundibwa.
strings.stage.summary.post_a_trip_of: Teekawo olugendo lwo, oba laba entebe ky'egwanidde <small>Gabana · abantu bo, ebbeeyi entuufu ey'oluguudo egabanyiziddwa mu ntebe</small>
strings.stage.h3.offer_a_seat_or: Waayo entebe, oba laba entebe ky'egwanidde okusasulwa
strings.stage.p.posted_trips_live_only: Entambula z'oteekawo zisigala mu bulawuza buno bwokka okutuusa lw'oyingira. Gabana egoberera enkola Pool app gye yamanyisa: akawunti ezikakasiddwa n'essimu, okunyumya mu lugendo, n'okuwa obubonero eruuyi n'eruuyi, ng'ogattako ebibinja by'abantu b'omanyiiko.
strings.rent.p.self_drive_by_the: Weevugire okusinziira ku lunaku, ne dereeva okusinziira ku ssaawa, oba emmotoka za Signature okutuuka bwe kuba kye kikulu. Ebbeeyi eba ya buli muntu bw'ogigabana.
strings.deliver.h2.send_the_thing_any: Tuma ekintu. Kya bunene bwonna, ku bbanga lyonna.
strings.deliver.p.every_courier_in_town: Kkampuni zonna ezitwala ebintu mu kibuga, ku sikuliini emu, nga zisengekeddwa. Ebweru wa Kampala, ekipakati kitambulira mu buuti y'emmotoka ya siteegi ku kimu kya kuna ky'entebe, ate mu biseera by'amakungula, taxi, pikapu oba loole ne dereeva.
strings.deliver.p.courier_rates_are_ug: Ebbeeyi z'abatwala ebintu kubalirira kwa UG okuva mu nkola efulumiziddwa; 8 to 8 e Jinja eyitibwa okuva mu biragiro by'omutandisi era ebbeeyi yaayo ebalirirwa. Ekipakati ku Siteegi ye bbeeyi ya UG yennyini: kimu kya kuna ky'entebe ku siteegi eyo, esasulwa dereeva awamu n'entebe.
strings.explore.div.explore_the_pearl_priced: Kyalira · Luulu ya Afirika, ku bbeeyi ey'amazima
strings.explore.h2.the_whole_park_weekend: Wiikendi yonna mu paaka, ennamba emu.
strings.explore.p.park_entry_permits_vehicle: Okuyingira paaka, ppaamiti, ssente z'emmotoka, lodge, ssente za rolex n'oluguudo olugendayo, bibalirirwa abatuuze ba Afirika ey'Ebuvanjuba, abagwira ababeera wano n'abagenyi. Abatuuze ba Afirika ey'Ebuvanjuba basasula ebbeeyi z'Afirika ey'Ebuvanjuba.
strings.explore.summary.chain_a_whole_day: Teekateeka olunaku lwonna <small>Hustle Mode · buli kitundu ky'olugendo kibalirirwa ku ngeri esinga obulayisi ekigwanira; wallet n'enteekateeka bya kugezesa</small>
strings.explore.div.ug_wallet_sandbox_balance: UG Wallet · ssente za kugezesa, si za mazima
strings.drive.h2.say_where_you_are: Gamba w'omanyi obulungi, omulundi gumu. Kkiriza emmotoka ezijjudde.
strings.drive.p.no_posting_no_waiting: Tewali kuteekawo, tewali kulindirira ku siteegi, tewali kuwanyisiganya bbeeyi. Maapu yo ey'Obwesigwa kye kintu kyokka ky'olabirira: w'osibuka, obwesengejje, amakubo, essaawa, ne by'ogaana ddala. Ebiweebwayo ebisasuliddwa bijja nga ssente zaamu zimaze okuteekebwamu.
strings.drive.summary.where_demand_is_coming: Abantu gye banaaba beetaaga entambula wiiki eno <small>Foresight · amakungula, embeera z'ebifo n'emikolo, wiiki emu mu maaso, buli kika ky'emmotoka</small>
strings.drive.p.promise_to_be_there: Suubiza okubaawo, ebbanga lifunda eri buli omu. Obwesige bulagibwa ku buli kabonero; ebiseera by'omwaka biba mateeka okutuusa amakungula agasooka lwe gabiyigiriza.
strings.drive.span.confidence_is_shown_per: Obwesige bulagibwa ku buli kabonero; ebiseera by'omwaka biba mateeka okutuusa nga waliwo entambula ezijjudde ez'okuyigirako.
strings.install.h2.the_site_is_the: Omukutu ye app. Giteekewo, oba sikaani koodi.
strings.install.p.one_link_on_the: Omukutu gumu ku mutimbagano ne ku ssimu: akawunti ye emu, siteegi ze zimu, Crest ye emu ku sikuliini y'awaka. Tewali kugenda mu sitoowa.
strings.install.p.scan_with_the_camera: Sikaani ne kkamera. Koodi eggulawo omukutu guno gwe gumu; yingira n'ennamba ye emu, byonna biba wano.
strings.install.p.ride_pool_rent_deliver: Genda. Gabana. Pangisa. Tuma. Akatale k'entambula aka Uganda ak'abantu abalina gye balaga era abalina bbaagyeti gye bakwata.
strings.modal.span.checkout_by_flutterwave_sandb: Okusasula kuyita mu Flutterwave · kya kugezesa okutuusa nga ekisumuluzo ekituufu kiteekeddwawo
strings.plugModal.label.api_key_or_token: Ekisumuluzo kya API oba tokeni (kikuumibwa ku kyuma kino)
strings.railModal.span.booked_and_tracked_on: Kikwatiddwa era kigoberezebwa ku UG. Omuweereza (concierge) mu kigezesebwa kino wa kugezesa bugezesa.
strings.railModal.div.high_contraststronger_text: Enjawulo ya langi enneneEbigambo, ennyiriri n'ensalo ebisinga okulabika
strings.railModal.div.reduce_motionno_opening_an: Kendeeza ebitambulaTewali kubikkula kwa kutandika, tewali butundutundu butambula, tewali kweyoleka mpola
strings.railModal.div.underline_linksevery_link_: Kola olukoloboze wansi w'emikutuBuli mukutu gulina olukoloboze, si langi yokka
strings.railModal.p.ug_also_follows_your: UG era egoberera enteekateeka z'essimu yo ez'okukendeeza ebitambula n'enjawulo ya langi, ekola ne sikuliini rida (ebitundu, ebipande n'ebifo ebikyuka), etambulirwamu ne kiibodi okuva ku ntandikwa okutuuka ku nkomerero, era ewulira ebiragiro by'eddoboozi okuyita mu ppeesa ya mayikolofooni oba mu profayilo ya Cephable. Tubuulire ekiyinza okuyamba: hello@ug.example.
strings.ops.p.every_town_on_the: Buli kibuga ku maapu kkubo okuva e Kampala era siteegi ku bwakyo. Awali app ey'ekitundu emaze okukola, UG ekwasa yo ekitundu ekisembayo mu kifo ky'okwefuula nti eriyo.
strings.ops.h2.maps_from_felt_climate: Maapu okuva ku Felt. Enkola z'embeera y'obudde okuva ku Infrared City. Eby'okwesanyusaamu okuva ku Tazama. Okufuga awatali kukozesa ngalo okuva ku Cephable.
strings.ops.p.each_plug_in_is: Buli kiyungibwako kya kuyunga ekirina endagiriro yaakyo n'ekisumuluzo kyakyo, ebiterekebwa ku kyuma kino okutuusa lw'oyingira. Yunga kimu, ppeesa ezikwatagana zaaka mu Gabana, Kyalira ne Hustle Mode. Tewali kiva mu UG awatali kiyungibwako ky'okoleezezza.
strings.ops.h2.competitors_are_listed_on: Abavuganya bateekeddwa ku lukalala mu bugenderevu. Omusaabaze eyeesiga okugeraageranya akomawo okugabana n'okupangisa.
strings.ops.p.ug_is_a_marketplace: UG katale okusooka. App z'okuyita emmotoka zifuna ebikwatiddwa ebimaze okujjuzibwa nga tezisasudde kufuna bakasitoma. Abapangisa emmotoka bafuna abapangisa ba wiikendi abakebereddwa. Lodge zifuna ebibinja ebituuka ku lunaku olumanyiddwa. Badereeva bafuna oluguudo olujjudde nga tebannasimbula.
strings.ops.p.verified_drivers_and_plates: Badereeva ne nnamba z'emmotoka ezikakasiddwa, SOS mu lugendo egabana w'oli mu kaseera ako n'omuntu gw'olonda, enkuufiira ku buli boda egabanibwa, ne lisiiti ku buli ssiringi.
strings.ops.p.ten_percent_on_pool: Kkumi ku buli kikumi ku kugabana, ssente entongole ez'okuteekawo emmotoka ku kupangisa, okusasulwa buli wiiki ku MoMo okuyita mu Flutterwave, ne bakasitoma b'otalina kwerangira.
strings.ops.p.deep_links_that_open: Emikutu eggulawo app yo nga w'okimibwa ne w'ossibwa bimaze okujjuzibwa. Tetulaga bbeeyi gye tutabalirira mu lwatu, era enkola efulumiziddwa.
strings.langNote: Ebiwandiiko ebitannakeberebwa muzaaliranwa bidda mu Lungereza ekigambo we kibula. Tuyambe okumaliriza olulimi lwo.
strings.ui.reviewNote: Enkyusa zaawandiikibwa UG ne zikeberebwa omulundi ogwokubiri; okukebera kw'abazaaliranwa kukyaggule. Ebigambo ebibula bidda mu Lungereza.
